notes: Maintainer explicitly requested and authorized publication; manual reviewed merge, no auto-merge.
All sources executed to completion through the canonical exported runtime. Exact independent board-ID/URL inventories and official linked posting URLs checked.
Source-record counts can overlap across translations and evergreen inventories, so they are not a unique vacancy count.
Full descriptions are absent where the current runtime cannot safely identify structured descriptions. Warnings and original posting links remain available; no description-count cap was added.
Machinex explicitly advertises Canadian and US openings on its native English board; the substantially larger French board is also included.

Lauzon has 21 published jobs across six load-more pages. The official UI query and total match the complete public WordPress emploi API; all records are collected, rather than only the first four visible cards.
Prolam excluded: inline positions share page URLs and need canonical feed identity support before admission; publishing the narrower Canadian syndication would omit advertised US roles.
Ciment Quebec official careers pages explicitly link both the Ciment Quebec and Unibeton boards; the latter is a division, not an unrelated employer.
FreeHire directory is a mutable paged observation, paired with current identity, alias and domain screening; absence is point-in-time evidence.

Revision 2 excludes St-Bruno general unsolicited-application entry 17539770 as a non-job. All 13 advertised vacancies remain; each has a full description. Other 24 source proofs remain their original timestamped observations; boards can add vacancies between validation and collection.
runtime_change: Canonical terminal listing checkpoints refresh on the next run even when structured descriptions are unavailable; detail success/retry caches and resumed-snapshot absence semantics remain intact. Regression tests cover a yielded detail traversal followed by discovery of a newly advertised role.
